facts.value: Museums and heritage organizations shape how communities understand their past and imagine their future. The Master of Arts in museum and curatorial practices at Arizona State University, offered online, prepares you to engage with art museums, heritage sites and curatorial projects through inclusive, forward-looking practices. You’ll build skills in research, interpretation and exhibition development to support careers in curating, education, research and related museum fields.
facts.programme_association: Online Master of Arts in Museum and Curatorial Practices

facts.value: Applicants must fulfill the requirements of both the Graduate College and the Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts. Degrees in the social sciences (history, anthropology, archaeology) and the arts (art history, museum studies) are most helpful to prepare students, but not required.
